journey.name: HomeToDetailNavigationJourney
journey.description: Verifies that a user can launch the app, see the home screen image grid, tab onthe first image, and successfully navigate to its detail screen

actions.action: Launch the PinterestStyleGridDemo app. After the app loads, check that a grid of images is visible on the home screen. Then, tap on the very first image in the grid. Finally, verify that a new screen appears showing the details of the image.
